verses.text: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.

xrefs.text: A song of ascents. Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
His mercy extends to those who fear Him, from generation to generation.
I delight in Your commandments because I love them.
Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the voice of His Servant? Who among you walks in darkness and has no light? Let him trust in the name of the LORD; let him lean on his God.
Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.

verses.text: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

xrefs.text: I will establish My covenant as an everlasting covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.
They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.
The righteous man walks with integrity; blessed are his children after him.
This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off— to all whom the Lord our God will call to Himself.
His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.

verses.text: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.

xrefs.text: The house of the righteous has great treasure, but the income of the wicked is trouble.
Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.
But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.
He will be the sure foundation for your times, a storehouse of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is Zion’s treasure.
I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.

verses.text: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright— for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.

xrefs.text: Your life will be brighter than noonday; its darkness will be like the morning.
Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart.
Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
Little children, let no one deceive you: The one who practices righteousness is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.
and if you give yourself to the hungry and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will go forth in the darkness, and your night will be like noonday.

verses.text: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.

xrefs.text: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and giving.
So you will follow in the ways of the good, and keep to the paths of the righteous.
Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.
I went past the field of a slacker and by the vineyard of a man lacking judgment.

verses.text: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.

xrefs.text: The memory of the righteous is a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
For God is not unjust. He will not forget your work and the love you have shown for His name as you have ministered to the saints and continue to do so.
A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.

verses.text: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

xrefs.text: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.
But whoever listens to me will dwell in safety, secure from the fear of evil.”
My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.
The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
[“]Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.

verses.text: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.

xrefs.text: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.
Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.
Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them.

verses.text: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.

xrefs.text: And do not neglect to do good and to share with others, for with such sacrifices God is pleased.
“All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”
As it is written: “He has scattered abroad His gifts to the poor; His righteousness endures forever.”
Suppose a brother or sister is without clothes and daily food.
Instruct them to do good, to be rich in good works, and to be generous and ready to share,

verses.text: The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.

xrefs.text: The hope of the righteous is joy, but the expectations of the wicked will perish.
May they vanish like water that runs off; when they draw the bow, may their arrows be blunted.
The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,
There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves are thrown out.
Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
